briefs.name: Ultra-Low Budget Recipe
briefs.whyItWorks: Hooks viewers with a relatable 'broke student' persona contrasting high dining costs with an easy sub-$3 meal tutorial.
briefs.hookPattern: I don't understand why people spend [amount] on [item] when you can make it for under [budget].

beats.shows: Creator presenting delicious prepared meal with fork pull.
beats.says: I do not understand why people spend twenty dollars on dinner when you can make this for under three.

beats.shows: Fast-paced assembly of inexpensive staple ingredients into a skillet.
beats.says: I'm a broke student, and here is how to make creamy veggie pasta in ten minutes.

beats.shows: Sauce simmering and cheese melting over the dish.
beats.says: Toss everything together, let it simmer, and dinner is served.

beats.shows: Creator taking a bite with an approving smile.
beats.says: Follow for more budget student meals.

evidence.spokenHook: Ich verstehe nicht, warum Menschen sagen, sie haben kein Geld und dann trotzdem jeden Abend
onScreenText: Gemüsepfanne und um nichts mehr zu verpassen
topComments: Jetzt hab ich Lust auf Schupfnudeln und Brokkoli 😁
Statt Sahne, nehme ich auch gerne Kräuterfrischkäse zum kochen, bringt auch nochmal mehr Geschmack rein. Liebe das 🫶🏼
"Ja hallo ich hätte gern 3 Kirschtomaten und 4 einzelne Sprossen Brokolli für mein 1,90 Rezept" 🥲
Ohhh, das sieht so, so lecker aus 🫶🫶🫶

briefs.name: Walking Student Deal Guide
briefs.whyItWorks: Uses a POV walking route directly from a campus landmark to a budget deal, making the savings tangible and locally relevant.
briefs.hookPattern: Did you know that if you walk right out of [campus building] you can get [budget offer]?

beats.shows: Host standing right outside a recognizable campus landmark, gesturing to start walking.
beats.says: Did you know that if you walk right out of the student union, there's a secret student discount?

beats.shows: Fast forward walk-through past local street corners and storefronts.
beats.says: Just head two blocks down past the station and keep going straight.

beats.shows: Entering the shop and showing the counter displaying budget options.
beats.says: You get ten percent off your entire meal just by showing your student card.

beats.shows: Close-up of fresh comfort food being served.
beats.says: Perfect when you need cheap comfort food between classes.
